register.title: Audit register
register.text: Every factory and audit service with the days left, worked out from the official expiry day.
register.group_reads: You see every factory of the group here. To add or change a factory's audits, switch to its company.
register.none_text: No audit fits these filters. Clear them to see the whole register.
register.empty_text: Add your factories' audits one by one, or import them from an Excel file.
register.no_services: First add the audit services you follow (BSCI, WRAP, ISO…), then your factories' audits.

add.title: Add an audit
add.expiry_hint: Proposed from the last audit: certificates usually last {months} months.
add.no_dates: The official dates are set by the people allowed to: add the audit now, they set its dates.

dates.title: Set the official dates
dates.saved: Dates saved. Days left and reminders follow the new expiry day.
dates.proposed: Proposed expiry: {date} ({months} months after the last audit).
dates.reason_hint: For example: new certificate received, extension letter. Kept in the history.

drawer.title: Audit
drawer.dates_by: Only people allowed to set official dates change the last audit and expiry days.

lists.title: Services, kinds and providers
lists.text: What the register is made of. A group keeps them for all its companies; a company may add its own.
lists.empty_services_text: Add the usual ones (BSCI, WRAP, SMETA, ISO, Higg…) or your own.
lists.empty_types_text: Add the usual ones (initial, renewal, surveillance…) or your own.
lists.empty_providers_text: Add the firms that audit your factories. A provider connected on the platform is marked.
lists.validity_hint: Proposes the expiry day from the last audit.
lists.name: Name
lists.connection_hint: Link it to the provider's connection: renewal requests and their results then go over it.
lists.connection_none: None of your business connections can be linked. Connect with the provider first (Business connections).

import.title: Import from Excel
import.text: Bring your existing register in from an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file. It is checked first; nothing is stored until you import.
import.fill: Fill in one audit per row: the factory and service by name or code, dates like 2026-10-31 or 31/10/2026.
import.choose: Choose the file: it is checked at once.

columns.factory: company or branch name (English or Bangla)
columns.provider: provider name (a new one is added)
columns.audit_type: kind of audit code or name

import.pick: Choose an Excel or CSV file
import.all_good: Every row is ready to import.

renewal.title: Request a renewal
renewal.on_platform: {provider} is on the platform: they receive the request in their own account and answer it here.
renewal.off_platform: {provider} is not on the platform: the request is noted here and an email is ready for you to send.
renewal.wanted_by_hint: Optional: the day you need the new certificate by.
renewal.recorded: Request noted. Send the email to the provider.
renewal.mail_ready: Send this to the provider by email (or copy it into a message):
renewal.copy_failed: Could not copy: select the text and copy it by hand.
renewal.not_delivered: It did not reach the provider (their side does not receive renewal requests yet). Contact them directly.
renewal.cancel_text: {provider} is told when they are on the platform. You can make a new request later.
renewal.needs_provider: Choose the provider below first: the request goes to them.
renewal.not_receiving: {provider} is on the platform, but their side does not take renewal requests yet: the request is noted here and an email is ready for you to send.

results.new_line: This audit is not in your register yet: accepting it adds the line.
results.apply_text: The register line takes the dates, result and certificate {from} sent. Days left and reminders follow the new expiry day.
results.reject_text: The register stays as it is. Say why, so it is clear later.

renewals.title: Renewals
renewals.text: Renewal requests to your audit providers, their answers, and the results they send for you to check.
renewals.none_text: Open a line of the register and press "Request renewal" to ask its provider.

quotes.title: Quotation {number}
quotes.accept_text: {from} will be told that you accept {total}.
quotes.decline_text: {from} will be told, with your reason.
quotes.accept_done: Quotation accepted; the provider has been told.
quotes.decline_done: Quotation declined; the provider has been told.

invoices.title: Invoice {number}
invoices.bill_text: A draft bill from {from} for {total} is made in Accounting. Add your input VAT code there, then submit it.
invoices.no_books: This company does not keep books here, so the invoice stays here only.
invoices.void_after_bill: The provider voided this invoice after you took it into the books. Check the bill in Accounting.
